intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Four countries urge Israel to let tents into Gaza
items.text: The foreign ministers of Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK have jointly urged Israel to stop the delays and let aid into Gaza. They asked for 150,000 tents and other critical supplies to be allowed in before winter. Flooding from the first winter storm has made life harder for people there. The ministers called the crisis entirely reversible and asked Israel to open more crossings. They also asked it to admit so-called dual-use items.

gloss.urge: to ask someone strongly to do something
gloss.crossing: a place where people or goods can pass over a border
gloss.reversible: able to be changed back to how it was before
gloss.dual-use items: goods that can be used for both civilian and military purposes
gloss.before winter: earlier than the start of the cold season

items.title: Estonia to close all border crossings with Russia
items.text: Estonia has said it will close all its border crossings with Russia from 1 December. The foreign minister, Margus Tsahkna, said the decision followed a failed sabotage attempt on an Estonian defence company. Al Jazeera reported that eight people had been arrested over an attempted arson attack on a drone maker. Tallinn says Russian intelligence ordered the attack.

gloss.sabotage: deliberate damage to stop something from working
gloss.arson: the crime of setting fire to a building on purpose
gloss.arrest: to take someone away because the police think they broke the law
gloss.intelligence: secret information about other countries, or the agency that collects it
gloss.border crossing: an official place where people pass from one country to another

items.title: Thousands march in Edinburgh against AI data centres
items.text: Thousands of people have protested in Edinburgh against plans for large AI data centres in Scotland. Data centres are large buildings full of computers that store information and run artificial intelligence programs. Campaigners have raised concerns about the plans.

gloss.data centre: a building that holds many computers for storing and processing information
gloss.demonstrator: a person who takes part in a public protest
gloss.campaigner: a person who works to bring about a change
gloss.raise concerns: to say that you are worried about something
gloss.large-scale: very big in size or number

items.title: England beat Spain 3-2 with ten men in Madrid
items.text: England have beaten Spain 3-2 in Madrid in the Nations League, even though they played with ten men. Spain came back late in the game but could not level the score. The result ended Spain's run of 43 matches without defeat. England finished top of the group on goal difference. In the same round, France beat Turkey 2-1 in Bordeaux to win Group A1.

gloss.unbeaten run: a series of matches without a loss
gloss.level the score: to score a goal that makes the result equal
gloss.goal difference: the number of goals scored minus the number conceded
gloss.with ten men: with one player fewer after a sending-off

items.title: Zverev beats Jodar in ATP Finals opener
items.text: Alexander Zverev opened his ATP Finals campaign in Turin with a 6-4, 6-4 win over Rafael Jodar on Sunday. The German hit ten aces and did not serve a double fault. He broke Jodar in the seventh game of the first set and again early in the second. Jodar, aged 20, is playing in the event for the first time. Zverev, a two-time champion, now looks ahead to a meeting with Ben Shelton on Tuesday.

gloss.ace: a serve that the opponent cannot touch
gloss.double fault: two bad serves in a row, which gives the opponent a point
gloss.break: to win a game when your opponent is serving
gloss.campaign: a series of matches or actions with one aim
gloss.look ahead to: to think about something that will happen soon

items.title: Vulcan rocket fails to deliver Amazon Leo satellites
items.text: ULA's Vulcan rocket has failed to put 40 Amazon Leo broadband satellites into orbit. The problem happened shortly after liftoff from Florida, when the rocket suffered what ULA called an in-flight anomaly. Amazon Leo is a planned network of satellites that will provide internet access. The rocket did not deliver the satellites to orbit.

gloss.liftoff: the moment a rocket leaves the ground
gloss.anomaly: something that is not normal or expected
gloss.orbit: the curved path of an object around the Earth
gloss.fault: a problem that stops a machine from working properly

items.title: Voyager 1 is about to reach one light-day from Earth
items.text: Voyager 1 will reach a distance of one light-day from Earth on Wednesday, according to NASA. It will be the first human-made object to do so. The spacecraft is about 16.1 billion miles away. A radio signal now takes at least 48 hours to travel there and back. NASA launched Voyager 1 on 5 September 1977.

gloss.light-day: the distance that light travels in one day
gloss.human-made: created by people, not by nature
gloss.spacecraft: a vehicle that travels in space
gloss.signal: a message sent by radio waves
gloss.round trip: a journey to a place and back again

items.title: Wu-Tang Clan and Phil Collins join Rock Hall
items.text: The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame held its 2026 ceremony at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Eighteen inductees were honoured. Wu-Tang Clan were inducted by Chris Rock and performed a medley that included C.R.E.A.M. Queen Latifah received the Early Influence Award and performed U.N.I.T.Y. with MC Lyte. Phil Collins was also inducted.

gloss.induct: to officially welcome someone as a member of a group or hall of fame
gloss.medley: several songs played one after another as one piece
gloss.ceremony: a formal event held to mark something special
gloss.honour: to show great respect for someone with a prize or title
gloss.early influence: someone who shaped music before others followed

items.title: US Treasury gives Nvidia ten days over export rules
items.text: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said Nvidia needs an outsider to lead the company. He has given its board ten days to show that it follows US export controls. Jensen Huang, Nvidia's co-founder, resigned as chief executive last week amid controversy. A petition asking for his return had more than 130,000 signatures by Sunday. Elon Musk said he had signed it.

gloss.export controls: government rules that limit which goods can be sold to other countries
gloss.board: the group of people who direct a company
gloss.resign: to leave your job by choice
gloss.petition: a written request signed by many people
gloss.embattled: under pressure and facing many problems

items.title: GTA VI pre-load opens on PS5 ahead of 19 November
items.text: Rockstar Games has opened pre-loading for Grand Theft Auto VI on PS5, so players can download the game before it goes on sale. The launch is set for 19 November, according to reports. Yahoo reported that GTA 6 is the most preordered game in both Sony and Xbox history. Rockstar has also said that the game encourages empathy, which is a first for the series.

gloss.pre-load: to download a game before its official release date
gloss.preorder: to pay for a product before it is on sale
gloss.launch: the start of selling a new product
gloss.empathy: the ability to understand how other people feel
